scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:server & pnpm run dev:desktop & wait
scripts.dev:server: docker compose --env-file server/.env -f server/compose.yml up -d postgres && (node scripts/run-with-server-env.mjs --filter @synapse/server run dev & node scripts/run-with-server-env.mjs --filter @synapse/dashboard run dev & wait)
scripts.quit:server: node scripts/quit-processes.mjs dev:server && APP_PUBLIC_URL=${APP_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:3000} docker compose --env-file server/.env -f server/compose.yml down
